name: ObbyWikiHomePage
description: Implements the custom home page for the Obby Wiki. Designed for the Citizen skin.
author: [https://obby.wiki The Obby Wiki]

ObbyWikiHomePageTitle.description: The title of the page to replace with the custom home page.

ObbyWikiHomePageCacheTTL.description: Cache TTL in seconds for the home page HTML. Set to 0 to disable caching. Default is 300 (5 minutes).

ObbyWikiHomePageFeaturedPages.description: An array of specific page titles to feature in the highlight carousel instead of automatically fetching them.

ObbyWikiHomePageDiscourseAnnouncementsJs.description: [DEPRECATED] Discourse JSON URL for tagged announcements (category + tag). Leave empty to hide the announcements section.

ObbyWikiHomePageDiscourseFetchPrimaryTop.description: [DEPRECATED] If true, perform one extra GET /t/{id}.json for the featured announcement only (first post text + author). Other topics use list excerpts only. Set false if the forum is slow or unreachable so the home page depends only on the tag list request.

ObbyWikiHomePageDiscordInvite.description: Discord invite URL shown in the home page contributing card and the Discord component embed. Leave this empty to hide the Discord links.

ObbyWikiHomePageBlogPostLimit.description: Maximum ModernBlog posts from the Blog namespace to show in the home page announcements section.

ObbyWikiHomePageBlogNamespaceName.description: Primary namespace name for ModernBlog posts (usually Blog).

ObbyWikiHomePageBlogTimelinePage.description: Timeline archive page name within the blog namespace (Blog:Timeline by default).

ObbyWikiHomePageTrendingLimit.description: Maximum number of trending pages to show on the home page (requires TrendingArticles).

ObbyWikiHomePageTrendingCategory.description: Category whose members are ranked for the home page Trending section (requires TrendingArticles).

ObbyWikiHomePageSpotlightAnimation.description: Use an animated image of the spotlight carousel in the Discord component embed. Falls back to a static thumbnail when Imagick or the output format is unavailable.

ObbyWikiHomePageSpotlightAnimationFormat.description: Output format for the spotlight animation: webp, avif or gif. AVIF is several times smaller than WebP but needs avifenc (libavif 1.x with SVT-AV1) on the server.

ObbyWikiHomePageSpotlightAnimationWidth.description: Canvas width of the spotlight animation in pixels; the height is width * 9 / 16. GIF output is capped at 800; AVIF is rounded down to a multiple of 32.

ObbyWikiHomePageSpotlightAnimationQualit.description: Lossy quality (1-100) for the spotlight animation. Null uses the format default: 80 for WebP, 50 for AVIF (avifenc's scale runs higher). Ignored for GIF.

ObbyWikiHomePageSpotlightAnimationMaxByt.description: Size budget in bytes for the spotlight animation. Over budget, the renderer lowers quality, frame counts and canvas size step by step.

ObbyWikiHomePageSpotlightAnimationFonts.description: Absolute paths to TTF files that override the bundled Inter fonts, e.g. for scripts Inter lacks.

ObbyWikiHomePageSpotlightAnimationAvifen.description: Path to avifenc for AVIF output. Null searches the usual bin directories and $PATH.
